steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Consumer Rights Act 2015 is the main law protecting consumers. It applies to goods, services, and digital content purchased in the UK. | Key Fact: Three key rights for goods: they must be as described (match their description), fit for purpose (do what the buyer reasonably expects), and of satisfactory quality (meet the standard a reasonable person would accept). | Key Fact: If goods are faulty: within 30 days — full refund; after 30 days but within 6 months — repair or replacement (retailer chooses); if repair/replacement fails — refund (with deduction for use after 6 months). | Key Fact: Services must be performed with reasonable care and skill, at a reasonable price, and within a reasonable time. If not, the consumer is entitled to a repeat performance or price reduction.
